release.name: Rivers and Rain
release.notes: Adds the world map, the ecosystems that live on it and the animal catalogue covering every phylum, class and order.

changes.change: World map generation: latitude bands, elevation, rivers and coastlines
Biome classification from temperature and rainfall
Ecosystem simulation with producers, herbivores and predators
Animal catalogue: every phylum, class and order with common names
Settings file, version info and update manifest

release.name: Interface Rebuild
release.notes: Rebuilds the interface around a ribbon menu, a left sidebar and a status bar.

changes.change: Top ribbon menu with File, Simulation, View, Options and Help
Left control sidebar with the simulation, rules and appearance groups
Bottom status bar with generation, population, size, speed and zoom
Keyboard shortcuts and mouse gestures on the grid

release.name: Project Restart
release.notes: First ArkansasIo build: the Conway engine with the biological model underneath it.

changes.change: Twenty-four rulesets, from Conway's Life to Walled Cities
Grid from 25 to 250 cells a side with zoom and history
Biological model: taxonomy, organisms, genomes, biomes
